//: Nx runs targets over the project graph (one project.json per project); Cargo resolves the Rust dependencies (one Cargo.lock) and npm the carrier's (one package-lock.json). The justfile always passes an explicit --base (tools/nx-base.sh), so defaultBase is never what the gate keys off. Cached targets that compile a dependency (lint, typecheck, doc) also hash that dependency's inputs (^default). Targets that run tests, write coverage profiles, build artifacts, or query advisories are uncached: a replay could not restore what they prove.
